subgoal_validations.details: The agent should make clear that Emma Chen (cust_001) has no orders and therefore cannot complete an exchange into PROD-FA0948.
explanations: Check: "The agent should make clear that Emma Chen (cust_001) has no orders and therefore cannot complete an exchange into PROD-FA0948." has failed.

The subgoal required the agent to clearly state that **Emma Chen (cust_001) has no orders**, and therefore **cannot complete an exchange into PROD-FA0948**. The agent did use tools, but it never established or communicated that fact. Instead, it searched broadly, misidentified the customer as other users (especially Maya Chen / `user_d3d5d0c8`), and concluded that exchange was impossible because deliveries were in the future. That is a different reason than the ground-truth subgoal. Since the agent did not make clear that **Emma Chen / cust_001 has no orders**, the subgoal was not achieved.

GRADE: I

The subgoal required the agent to make clear that Emma Chen (cust_001) has no orders and therefore cannot complete an exchange into PROD-FA0948. This depended on using available tools to identify the correct customer and inspect her orders. Although tools were available and used, the agent did not establish the ground-truth condition. Instead, it failed to use Emma’s actual customer ID, switched to other users (notably a different Maya/Emma-equivalent record), and concluded the exchange was impossible because deliveries were in the future—not because Emma Chen had no orders. Since the required finding (“Emma Chen has no orders”) was never correctly determined or clearly communicated, the subgoal was not achieved.
